purpose: Freeze a finite seven-route prevalue review of issuer-as-consumer-lender application, consent, underwriting, offer, acceptance, disbursement, scheduled repayment, payment allocation, delinquency, hardship, restructure, cure, default, charge-off, recovery, collateral repossession, sale, settlement and closure states before any source row, formula, direction, candidate value, comparator, security price or return is read.

adjacent_mentions_only: aggregate loan balance, origination, approval, yield, delinquency, NPL, charge-off and recovery KPIs without application-to-account-to-payment-to-collection conservation
issuer-as-corporate-borrower credit facilities and covenants rather than issuer-as-consumer-lender underwriting and servicing execution
bank portfolio asset-quality migration rather than privacy-safe application, offer, loan-account, payment, hardship, collections and collateral event state
deposit funding, payment processing and customer-experience histories rather than lender-owned credit origination and servicing obligations

requirements: lawful public or licensed point-in-time source with first-available, correction and supersession timestamps for application, consent, underwriting, offer, acceptance, disbursement, schedule, payment allocation, delinquency, hardship, restructure, cure, default, charge-off, recovery, collateral, repossession, sale, settlement and closure events mapped to accepted trading sessions

stable listed-parent plus privacy-safe application, offer, contract, loan-account, installment, payment, delinquency-case, hardship-plan, collection-case, collateral and settlement tokens without current-state projection

complete 2019-2023 applicable denominators including submitted, withdrawn, rejected, approved, offered, accepted, cancelled and disbursed applications; current, due, paid, late, cured, restructured, defaulted, charged-off, recovered and closed accounts; secured, perfected, repossessed, sold, deficient and settled collateral obligations

explicit missing, unavailable, rejected, cancelled, reversed, corrected, superseded, partial-payment, overpayment, delinquent, hardship, forbearance, restructure, cure, default, charge-off, recovery, repossession, sale, deficiency, settlement and genuine-zero semantics with application, account, schedule, payment, collection and collateral conservation

no borrower or natural-person identity, credit report, income, employer, bank account or payment credential, device or location data, collections communication, authentication or KYC document, sensitive personal data, underwriting-model parameters, fraud or security controls, customer-confidential terms, or trade secret

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: consumer_credit_application_consent_kyc_token_underwriting_decision_offer_acceptance_disbursement_cancellation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted lawful point-in-time source links a listed consumer lender to stable privacy-safe application, consent-state, underwriting-decision, offer, contract and loan-account tokens through submission, withdrawal, rejection, approval, acceptance, cancellation and disbursement with complete applicable denominators and revision clocks.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: consumer_loan_account_schedule_payment_allocation_delinquency_hardship_restructure_cure_default_chargeoff_recovery_closure_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a lawful point-in-time servicing history that conserves scheduled principal, interest and fees through due, partial or full payment, reversal, delinquency bucket, hardship, forbearance, restructure, cure, default, charge-off, recovery and closure for the complete applicable account population.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: secured_consumer_loan_collateral_valuation_perfection_repossession_sale_deficiency_settlement_release_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves privacy-safe loan and collateral identities through valuation, lien perfection, impairment, repossession, sale, proceeds allocation, deficiency, settlement and release with complete secured-loan denominators and correction histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: applications_approvals_originations_balances_yield_nim_delinquency_npl_chargeoff_recovery_customer_or_account_count_kpi_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign168 and Campaign187 already govern generic operating KPIs and bank loan-quality migration. Aggregate applications, approvals, originations, balances, yields, margins, delinquency, NPL, charge-off, recovery, customer or account counts do not preserve application-to-loan-to-payment-to-collection transitions or complete failed and pending denominators.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: corporate_credit_facility_bank_portfolio_deposit_payment_processing_or_customer_experience_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign170, 182, 187, 192 and 195 govern customer-experience KPIs, issuer borrowing facilities, bank portfolio quality, deposits and payment processing. Their issuer roles, identities and clocks cannot be relabelled as a complete issuer-as-consumer-lender application, underwriting, servicing, collections and collateral lifecycle.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: current_loan_product_rate_card_credit_policy_portfolio_snapshot_accounting_receivable_allowance_or_credit_bureau_snapshot_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Current product catalogs, rate cards, credit policies, portfolio or bureau snapshots, and accounting receivable or loss-allowance snapshots cannot reconstruct historical applications, decisions, account schedules, payments, hardship actions, collections, recoveries and complete applicable populations at first availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: issuer_product_channel_score_cohort_geography_application_decision_loan_delinquency_collateral_collection_direction_threshold_age_subset_weight_interaction_combination_or_model_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Selecting an issuer, product, channel, score, cohort, geography, application decision, loan class, delinquency bucket, collateral type, collection path, direction, threshold, age, subset, weight, interaction, combination or model before complete lawful base histories are admitted would multiply hypotheses and exploit privacy, coverage, correction, class and survivorship differences.

scientific_interpretation: A linked issuer-as-consumer-lender application, underwriting, loan-account, payment, delinquency, collections and collateral lifecycle is economically distinct from issuer borrowing facilities, aggregate bank portfolio quality, deposits and payment processing. Distinction alone does not admit a factor; the absent complete lawful point-in-time privacy-safe operating source is the binding gate.
next_action: Bind the three infrastructure failures and all seven scientific routes into one append-only ledger, publish terminal prevalue evidence, and authorize a genuinely different Campaign225 domain after validation.
